text_blocks.text: It's a good challenge for me. You can only get better from here. New to it, so you only can get better and that's the main thing, just trying to get better. He's one of the best in the league, especially at scoring, so got to be able to shut him down.

quotes.speaker: Brayden Burries
quotes.summary_phrase: Brayden Burries on film study and defensive preparation
quotes.excerpt: The coaches do a great job of scout with the scouting report and then my own personal,
quotes.quote: The coaches do a great job of scout with the scouting report and then my own personal, I just watch them, see which way they like to go, is it right or left. See if can you shoot pretty well, if you can, I can go over, if not, I can go under and stuff. On the offensive side for us and the defensive side for them, how are they guarding us, are they pushing on the sides with icing, going under the screens, over screens. Little stuff like that I try to hold in on and then when we get in the game, try to see how they are doing that too.
quotes.social_post: Brayden Burries details his film study process, noting he focuses on tendencies like which way opponents prefer to drive and how they defend screens to prepare for game action.

structured.context: Brayden Burries explains his process for studying scouting reports and preparing for defensive assignments.

quotes.summary_phrase: Brayden Burries on his primary focus during games
quotes.excerpt: The first thing when I first get in the game, it's just how can I impact the game
quotes.quote: The first thing when I first get in the game, it's just how can I impact the game on defense, you know, and then trying to rebound. That's how I get going personally, is rebounding.
quotes.social_post: Brayden Burries says his primary focus when entering a game is his defensive impact and rebounding, noting that rebounding is how he personally gets going.

structured.context: Brayden Burries describes how he focuses on defense and rebounding to get himself going during games.

quotes.summary_phrase: Brayden Burries on building a next-play mentality
quotes.excerpt: You kind of got to have a short-term memory. So whether it was a bad play,
quotes.quote: You kind of got to have a short-term memory. So whether it was a bad play, whether I threw a bad pass or teammate threw a bad pass or got back-doored or something, just got to next play.
quotes.social_post: Brayden Burries on maintaining focus after mistakes: You have to have a short term memory. Whether it is a bad pass or a defensive breakdown, you just have to move on to the next play.
